The version is from May 2019. The issue 42475209 is a use-of-uninitialized-value in freetype2. Let me look at the OSS-Fuzz issue. Since I can't access it directly, let me think about what the fix might be.

Let me search for known freetype2 use-of-uninitialized-value fixes around this time. Let me look at the git log after this commit to find the fix. But we only have the vulnerable version. Let me think about what could cause uninitialized value in the PDF rendering path.

Let me look at the freetype2 source for potential uninitialized value issues. Let me check the git history of the actual freetype2 repo to find the fix for this issue. Let me search online.
